objective: Cut the input tokens per review for Rex and Hakim against a recorded baseline by setting omitClaudeMd with a short floor-rules block and trimming the Rex prompt, with no per-entry review-quality change beyond the measured run-to-run variance.
why: ac4-1 to ac4-3 are not-verified. Neither agent sets omitClaudeMd. .claude/agents/code-reviewer.md is about 73 KB and CLAUDE.md about 22 KB. code-reviewer.md does not repeat the always-on floor rules (ticket vocabulary and 80% coverage and git add rules) it enforces from CLAUDE.md. /eval-agents records no token usage, and docs/eval-agents/corpus/hakim.json has 4 entries. Every PR pays for at least one Rex review, so the saving repeats on every merge.

include: Define and script the token measurement: per-message usage from the subagent transcript with cache-read tokens counted separately
Mine Hakim CHANGES REQUESTED rounds to grow the Hakim corpus to at least 10 entries that follow docs/eval-agents/SCHEMA.md
Record a baseline of tokens per review and k /eval-agents runs for Rex and Hakim before any change
Set omitClaudeMd in both agent files and add a short block with the always-on floor rules each agent enforces
Trim the Rex prompt without removing a check the corpus exercises
Re-measure tokens and re-run k evals and report per-entry verdict flips and the token drop in docs/eval-agents/reports/
exclude: A shared rules file for both agents (saves no tokens per review)
Changes to what Rex or Hakim block on
